title: Product settings (forms and inputs)
summary: A settings form built only from form elements: sectioned fields with help, counters and validation, money and stepper inputs, dual range, choice controls, tag and colour inputs, a drop zone and a sticky action bar.
built: Form, Form section, Field, Input, Textarea, Select, Range, Checkbox, Radio group, Switch, Tag input, Colour input, Dropzone, Form actions, Button.
mobile: The form is one column; controls keep a 44px height and 16px text so a phone does not zoom on focus.
